Greater Mummy (Undead)
Hollow One, Guardian, Unraveler, Horadrim Ancient

Just as he did with the mummified bodies that slept beneath the sands of Lut Gholein, Mephisto bound the spirits of his most powerful demonic minions to the corpses of the greatest warriors and mages of Aranoch. Natural leaders in life, they continue their positions of dominance within the ranks of the undead, rallying hordes of mummies about them as they seek the flesh of the living. Moving slightly faster than their lesser followers, their scythe-like arms deliver devastating blows to any who move within striking distance. Their breath, filled with the vapors of the grave, is a deadly poison that has claimed the lives of many would-be heroes. These undead horrors also cast bolts of unholy energy at their enemies and can also raise the bodies of their undead minions, making them immediate targets whenever they are encountered.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Greater Mummies are capable of raising and healing other undead (with Unique and Champion monsters being an exception). They shoot Unholy Bolts from a distance and use a poison breath attack in close quarters combat. Greater Mummies heal 50% faster than normal monsters.
